title: Bible places (OpenBible.info geocoding data)
rights: CC BY 4.0 (OpenBible.info Bible Geocoding Data, Stephen Smith); coordinates and geometries derive from OpenStreetMap (ODbL) and Wikidata among seventy modern sources listed in the dataset’s source.jsonl.
citation: Smith, Stephen. Bible Geocoding Data. OpenBible.info, 2023–. CC BY 4.0.
editorialMarkers: Identifications of ancient places with modern locations are the dataset’s, scored by confidence; many are approximate or disputed and the precision is recorded on each. A location is evidence of where a name has been placed on a map, never of a people’s identity.
method: ancient.jsonl → one place per record (name, translation names, verse list, first identification); modern.jsonl → the highest-scoring associated location with coordinates, type and precision; a reverse index verses/<osis>.json (chapter → verse → place ids). Geometry files (regions, rivers) are not copied.
